issue: gem.wiki coverage cross-check found a wiki-only page 'Gassi Touil LNG Terminal' (no export-CSV row) that is NOT a missing terminal: it is a stale duplicate of the existing Arzew-Bethioua GL3Z train. The wiki page itself locates the liquefaction plant at 'Djedid gas port, Arzew' (coords 35.845, -0.306 — inside the Arzew complex) and its title source names it 'Gassi Touil LNG Arzew GL3Z'. Independent confirmation: the Arzew GL3Z train (onstream 2014, Sonatrach, Saipem/Chiyoda EPC) sources gas from the Gassi Touil and Rhourde Nouss fields — verified at https://www.oilandgasadvancement.com/projects/arzew-lng-algeria/ (url_verifier token 'Gassi Touil' PASS; corroborating pages at offshore-technology.com and gasstrategies.com are bot-blocked 403, live but unverifiable). The wiki page also carries long-obsolete ownership (Repsol 48%/Gas Natural 32%/Sonatrach 20% — the Repsol/Gas Natural contract was rescinded in 2007; Sonatrach built GL3Z alone).
suggested_action: No tracker edit needed (GL3Z already covered under Arzew-Bethioua). Flag to GEM staff that the orphan gem.wiki page 'Gassi Touil LNG Terminal' should be merged/redirected into the Arzew-Bethioua LNG Terminal page to prevent future discovery sweeps re-flagging it.
